name: aspen-edr-rating-delivery
title_zh: 换热器逐台补 EDR 评级，零警告交 BKP/APW
tagline_zh: HeatX 里 Detailed 和 Shortcut 长得像，EDR 漏没漏肉眼看不出来。
tagline_en: HeatX Detailed and Shortcut look alike, so a missing EDR is invisible. It reads back true EDR per unit, runs.
desc_en: Build, audit, repair, and deliver Aspen Plus EDR shell-and-tube exchanger ratings with complete HeatX coverage, non-GUI COM/file workflows, true-EDR readback, engineering acceptance gates, and exact BKP/APW zero-warning verification. Use when a user asks to add EDR to every exchanger, check whether EDR was omitted, distinguish HeatX Detailed/Shortcut from real EDR, automate EDR without GUI, bind o
why_zh: 不靠 GUI 点选，走 COM 与文件流；判定依据是真 EDR 回读值，不是模型名。缺一台就报一台。
why_en: No GUI clicking: COM and file workflows. Verdicts come from true EDR readback, not model names. One missing unit, one report.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Aspen Plus 的管壳式换热器 EDR 评级；本机要装带 EDR 授权的 Aspen Plus 与可用的…
limit_en: Shell-and-tube EDR rating in Aspen Plus only; needs a licensed EDR install and working COM. Plate, air-cooled and spiral units are out of scope.
title_en: EDR-rate every exchanger, deliver zero-warning BKP/APW
